proofs.verified_behavior: Static storage always reports false for uniqueness.
Uniqueness returns true exactly when the supplied successful Acquire load observes count1.
assumptions: Atomic load with Acquire ordering returns the supplied observed count; no ownership or concurrency invariant is proved.

proofs.verified_behavior: A successful uniqueness query is true iff its observed reference count equals1.
assumptions: Atomic load with Acquire ordering succeeds with the observed count; this is an observation-level property, not proof of exclusive memory access.
